datasets.title: Burundi Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 766.7 thousand buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 33% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 4 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 2% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset includes approximately 766.7 thousand mapped buildings with coverage estimates indicating ~33% of total buildings in Burundi, with data currency metrics tracking last edits and recent updates.
